مِرْزَحٌ The wood, or pieces of wood, (خَشَب,) with which a grape-vine is raised from the ground (T, S, K) when one part thereof has fallen down upon another: (T, TA:) or a vine-prop; a piece of wood with which a grape-vine is raised from the ground. (TA in art. جزء.) ＝
-A2- Also, as an epithet in which the quality of a subst. predominates, [but why this is said I do not see, unless the primary meaning be that assigned by EshSheybánee to the next following word,] A voice, sound, or noise; (TA;) and so ↓ مِرْزِيحٌ : (K:) accord. to Esh-Sheybánee, the latter signifies
having a vehement voice or sound or noise; (S;) but this [said to be] is a mistake. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
